name: Wanderlight
lore: The antlered lantern guardian of Wayfarer Wilds. Every trail leaves a story, and every story can be walked again. Hero 40.

primary.name: Lantern Comet
primary.description: A weaving lantern shot deals 26 damage and flies for about 4 seconds (1200 reach), giving you time to redirect it. Records the last four firing positions.

secondary.name: Compass Turn
secondary.description: Redirect flying lanterns and infuse them with your current element. Earth: 12 splash damage, poison 2/s for 4s; roots grow after 2s and slow by 45% for 8s after growing. Fire: 20 splash damage and burn 3/s for 4s; lava lasts 8s and renews burn on contact. Both have 85 radius. Starts as Earth. With no flying bolts, launch an infused 16-damage light.

special.name: Walking Chronicle
special.description: Replay your last four shots from their original positions, 0.25s apart at 65% damage. After the last replay, switch Earth to Fire or Fire to Earth for future redirections. Starts as Earth. Walls block shots.

passive: Trailkeeper: Compass Turn grants a 30% movement boost for 1 second.

technique.name: Swift Lantern
technique.description: Lantern Comets travel 35% faster but have 20% less reach and less redirection time.

final_technique.name: Wayfarer Beacons
final_technique.description: Place two warning beacons for 20 damage each and short slows. Replaces bolt redirection; this alternative does not add elemental terrain.

attack.name: Wayfarer Beacons
attack.description: Place two warning beacons for 20 damage each and short slows. Replaces bolt redirection; this alternative does not add elemental terrain.
